title: Recognition Video Narration Spec
description: Sub-line A artifact. Owns narration text design + TTS configuration before audio-plan / composition. Enforces target-character frequency, concrete anchor phrase, quantifier-vs-numeral separation, and child-readable sentence complexity so the spoken body cannot drift into poetic narration that loses recognition signal.

targetCharacter.description: The Chinese character the child must learn (e.g. "一", "二", "山"). Must appear inside script and concreteAnchorPhrase.phrase.

targetCharSemantic.description: Category of the target character. "number" (一/二/三/十) triggers the strictest quantifier-vs-numeral check because 一道光 is a quantifier, not a count.

script.description: Full narration text the TTS engine will speak. Must be the concatenation of segments[].text in order (no extra characters).

segments.description: Script split into ordered sentence segments. Each segment must stay short enough for a 3-6 year old to follow.

text.description: Single sentence. Hard cap 12 characters because longer lines lose 3-6 year olds. Trailing 。/？/！ counts toward the cap.

role.description: Functional role. concrete-anchor binds the target character to a tangible object ("一根木棒"). glyph-naming explicitly names the character ("就念一"). At least one of each role is required by the validator.

targetCharOccurrences.description: Self-reported count of how many times targetCharacter appears in this segment.text. Validator cross-checks against the actual string.

shotIdHint.description: Optional. Which brief.shotPlan beat this segment is intended to land on. audio-plan will reconcile actual timing after TTS bake.

concreteAnchorPhrase.description: Mandatory functional sentence binding target character to a tangible object. Poetic framing is allowed elsewhere, but this anchor sentence must exist so that recognition can attach to a concrete referent.

segmentId.description: Must match one segment whose role is "concrete-anchor".

phrase.description: The exact concrete-anchor phrase ("一根木棒", "一只小船"). Must contain targetCharacter and a concrete noun.

anchorObject.description: The concrete noun the child should picture (e.g. "木棒", "小船").

quantifierUsage.description: Inventory of every place the target character appears in a quantifier construction ("一道/一只/一根/一条/..."). When targetCharSemantic="number", every quantifier use must be backed by a visible count of the noun in the composition so that 一道光 still teaches "one" rather than the bare measure word.

kind.description: number-as-numeral: 一个/一根 + count visible. number-as-quantifier: 一道/一束 used purely as measure word without count anchor. non-numeral-use: target char appears in another word (e.g. 一定).

boundToVisualCount.description: True only when the composition explicitly shows exactly one of the anchored noun. False is allowed only for non-numeral-use; for number-as-quantifier it must be true or the spec fails.

visualReference.description: Where in the composition the count is shown (shotId / plate id / sprite id).

rate.description: Edge-TTS rate offset, e.g. "-10%". Validator enforces -15%..0% for child-facing narration.

tts.description: How bake-narration.mjs invokes the TTS engine. Recorded so the bake step is reproducible across characters.

commandTemplate.description: Shell template used by bake-narration.mjs. Must reference {{voice}}, {{rate}}, {{pitch}}, {{text}}, {{audioOut}}, {{subtitleOut}}.

apadToSeconds.description: When set, bake-narration.mjs runs ffmpeg apad to extend the mp3 to this total duration. Used when the clip has a silent stroke-order tail.

outputs.description: Paths produced by bake-narration.mjs. validate-narration-bake.mjs checks these exist and match the spec.

measuredTimings.description: JSON file produced by bake-narration.mjs with per-segment audioStart/audioEnd measured from the actual VTT, ready to be referenced by audio-plan.
